notes: Omen: new experience family Nothing, after the Nothing phone's design language: round-dot type (Doto, open-licensed), white rounded cards, segmented capsule bars, dashed outlines and halftone-dot discs. Glyph is the lock screen: the time…

Every Nothing style is laid out for every screen shape, from 240x240 up through bars, 16:9 and portrait, with its own small-screen design: Glyph is the time alone, Widgets one white clock card, and Ring the ring itself.

Round screens: a square panel can now be set Round in the Panel Editor's Position step (the Screen row appears for square sizes). The panel is then clipped to a circle, and a style that knows the shape draws for the circle. All three…
Fonts: Doto and Inter (both SIL Open Font License) are bundled with the experiences.
